subject: Close-to-live orchestration blueprint & evaluation slate
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Keller <suzanne.keller@astrahealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close-to-live orchestration blueprint & MAP — next steps

Hi Suzanne —

Congrats again on signing. Attached is the initial implementation blueprint I promised (Astra_MAP_v1.xlsx) plus a short evaluation checklist (eval-checklist-v2.md). High-level ask: confirm the proposed canary cadence and training windows so we can lock resource reservations with infra and support.

Key highlights from the MAP (summary):
- Rollout phases: 1) Internal pilot (week 0–2), 2) 5% canary (week 3), 3) 25% staged ramp (weeks 4–6), 4) full shift (week 8).
- Migration window: 02:00–05:00 UTC preferred for lower traffic — see rollout-windows.csv for blackout dates.
- Training: three 90-minute sessions (developer, ops, product); proposed dates in sheet.
- Eval plan: prompt/latency SLOs, regression prompt set, and automated quality checks at 5% and 25% gates.

Open items where we need your call:
1) Canary gating: do you want performance-only gating, or combined performance + manual quality review?
2) Integrator: are you planning to use Solareq for the connector work? If yes we should loop Miguel.
3) Acceptance criteria: can you confirm the internal teams who will sign off on the 25% gate?

Next steps (proposed):
- You review attachments and reply with preferences by Tue EOD (Sep 23).
- We'll update the MAP and publish a final mutual action plan + DocuSign for the SOW amendment.

Attachments referenced as stubs: Astra_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), eval-checklist-v2.md (markdown), rollout-windows.csv (csv).

Thanks —

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Suzanne Keller <suzanne.keller@astrahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close-to-live orchestration blueprint & MAP — next steps

On Fri, Sep 19, 2025 at 9:12 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Suzanne —
> 
> Congrats again on signing. Attached is the initial implementation blueprint I promised (Astra_MAP_v1.xlsx)...

Thanks for the draft, Sergio — this is a good start. A couple of practical notes from an onboarding / CS perspective:

- Training cadence: can we move the developer session one week earlier? Astra's dev team said they have a feature freeze week starting Oct 6; if we push the dev training to Sep 29 it avoids conflicts.
- Rollback triggers: please add two explicit rollback triggers in the MAP: 1) latency regression >25% sustained for 10 minutes, 2) critical functional errors in top 5 customer flows (>2 errors/min). We should capture ownership for who hits the rollback button (CS ops + Astra SRE).
- Canary monitoring: request that we include a synthetic traffic test in the 5% canary for the top 3 flows — pass/fail threshold included in the eval-checklist.

If Suzanne confirms Solareq as integrator, we will add a short onboarding step for them into week 0 to get credentials and a dry-run.

Laura
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Suzanne Keller <suzanne.keller@astrahealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Miguel Ortega <miguel.ortega@solareq.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close-to-live orchestration blueprint & MAP — next steps

Thanks, Sergio and Laura —

Quick answers from Astra: we confirm Solareq as the integrator and want combined gating (automated performance + manual QA) at 5% and 25%. We can move the dev training to Sep 29 — that's fine.

On acceptance: sign-off for 25% gate will be Product (myself), SRE (Diego), and CS (Laura). I'll loop Diego directly into the sign-off thread once timelines are locked.

One ask: Miguel, please confirm that Solareq can attend a credentialing & dry-run slot in the week 0 window (Sep 22–26). We prefer a morning slot PST.

Regards,
Suzanne Keller
VP Product | AstraHealth
(suzanne.keller@astrahealth.com)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Keller <suzanne.keller@astrahealth.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, Miguel Ortega <miguel.ortega@solareq.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close-to-live orchestration blueprint & MAP — next steps

Great — thanks for the quick confirmation, Suzanne.

Action items I captured from this thread:
1) Move dev training to Sep 29 — Laura to update calendar invites.
2) Add explicit rollback triggers to the MAP and the eval-checklist (latency + error-rate thresholds) — Karthik to update by Mon (Sep 22).
3) Credentialing/dry-run for Solareq: Miguel to propose 2× morning PST slots between Sep 22–26.
4) Finalize sign-off roster for 25% gate (Product/SRE/CS) — Suzanne will loop Diego.
5) I'll publish a tidy MAP v1.1 and share a Drive link + DocuSign placeholder by Mon EOD.

I'll flag a separate calendar invite for the 5% canary readiness review (30 minutes) the morning of the canary day. If anyone needs a different cadence for the readiness review, tell me now.

Thanks all — looking forward to the runway.

Sergio
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
